notice: Roof profiles, orientation, heights, facade widths, roof ribs and all polygon vertices are visual reconstruction estimates. These reference facts are NOT per-venue surveyed CAD geometry or proof of OSU-grade photographic parity.

illinois.note: Folded thin-shell white concrete dome, radial supports and a recessed 360-degree glass band

indiana.note: Suspension saddle roof; north/south stand separation and expanded south entrance

iowa.note: Deep-set bowl below a low external roof of exposed steel trusses and curved glass-block walls

maryland.note: Large contemporary multi-level arena, broad roof and prominent stepped entrance, initial reference only

michigan.note: Low arena volume with brick and cast stone and the signature 36-foot-high oval glass entrance

michigan-state.note: Broad arena and 2017 Gilbert Pavilion expansion at the southeast corner

minnesota.note: 1928 field house with curved long-span roof and historic brick shell; raised floor is not yet digitized

nebraska.note: Oval metal/concrete mass and protruding multi-story glass lobby; split upper concourse

northwestern.note: Renovated 1953 fieldhouse, retained roof structure and expanded glass-lit corner circulation

oregon.note: Sweeping curved metal roof and extensive transparent entry facade with low bowl suites

penn-state.note: Low-profile bi-level mass of brick and glass with broad curved roof

purdue.note: Circular concrete and steel structure with distinctive warm-colored domed roof and brick exterior

rutgers.note: Unusual trapezoidal upper mass with angled metal siding and modest concrete entrance

ucla.note: Broad low roof over terracotta/glass wraparound concourse

usc.note: Tall concrete and brick perimeter with four corner turrets, large attached practice pavilion

washington.note: 1928 Romanesque brick hall with round arched windows, gable roof and ridge skylight

wisconsin.note: Wide rectilinear arena, pale roof and large multi-panel front curtain wall
